scientific_review.readout: Mean seed logits before AUROC; 145 fixed MACCS and 13 functional-group targets; 980/1,000 defined MACCS paired molecule bootstrap resamples; descriptive conditional intervals.
scientific_review.reconstruction: FVE versus the training mean is separated from original-unit relative L2; no blanket claim of superior reconstruction.
scientific_review.selection: All three frozen chemical candidates retained; missing concepts remain gaps; strongest test hydroxyl example explicitly illustrative in notes.
scientific_review.lineage: All histories start at 0; nominal exposure is not unique spectra; same dataset contract; native m/z quantization confound retained.
scientific_review.causal_scope: No isolated recipe effect, diffusion feature ablation, chemical sufficiency or fragment-assignment claim.
